description: This file defines a Perl module 'metadata' for parsing and handling package and target metadata in a build system, including functions for reading metadata files, managing package data structures, and handling user/group IDs.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, optionally prefixing lines.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Replaces certain characters in a string with underscores to generate a configuration string.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specifications from metadata, validating IDs and names, and updating corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses target metadata from a file, extracting target properties, profiles, and subtargets.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package metadata from a file, populating package, source, and related hashes.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package manifest metadata from a file, populating package hashes.
